_about: Ancillary services in Switzerland: part of the battery is kept out of the dispatch and earns a fixed rate per kW of reserved power.
rate_note: CHF/kW/yr, proxy revenue rate for reserved capacity

reserve.note: share of the usable SoC window (and the same share of inverter power) kept out of the dispatch for grid services; mode percent uses frac, fixed_kwh uses kwh (capped at the window)
